items.note: Aparājitapṛcchā (ch. 223) prescription of Cāmuṇḍā's attributes, as appended to Pande's Udayeśvara study; canonical iconographic text for comparison with the temple's mātṛkā panels.
Aparājitapṛcchā lists the mātṛkās (Vārāhī, Indrāṇī, Kaumārī, Brahmāṇī, Vaiṣṇavī, Maheśvarī) with attributes and mounts; canonical prescription for the mother goddesses.
